about: Every value name each seed module exported before the native contract (origin/dev at 22b48e13, the public seed the compiled stacks were last merged with, read with Object.keys of the imported module). A seed upgrade keeps any of them once the in-app agent edited it, so the native contract (loop/native-contract.ts and the modules that join it) may import only these names from an existing module: a name a raylib night needs comes from a module of its own.
